bagPolicy.summary: Frost Bank Center allows bags 12" x 12" x 6" or smaller, with magnetometer screening at entry. Bag policies may vary by event.
prohibited: Drawstring bags that exceed size limits
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are allowed and will be screened and tagged by Security.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Frost Bank Center can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Frost Bank Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Frost Bank Center offers a variety of food and drink options, including casual dining at The Agave Club and upscale public concessions at the Frost Club. Highlights include creative shareable appetizers at the ULTRA Club, brisket tacos at Davila's BBQ, and smashburgers at Roadhouse. The venue is cashless and features a wide selection of beverages, including premium cocktails and souvenir draft beers.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Frost Bank Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Frost Bank Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office opens 3 hours prior to the event start time.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Frost Bank Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
